id: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)

facts.text: Junior, put the diary down and eat. A pilgrimage is no good on an empty stomach.
facts.why: Henry Sr. does not say this in the film. A real line on the quote page suits him, and it fits the dog joke already in the house lines.

vibe.verdict: A very good tavern menu that uses the diary, the cups, the Zeppelin and the dog.
